column1: # insert A = GTAANNNNCTAG, 12 nt (a multiple of 3), barcode slot at offset 4-8.
# Hand-derived from the toy gene design in make_toy.py. NEVER regenerate this from pipeline output
# -- that would only prove the code agrees with itself.
# A dot means "this field must be empty". Every row must have exactly as many fields as the header.
# dist_to_last_junction = last_junction_pos - (ptc_tx_pos + 3), measured from the END of the stop
# codon; nmd_expected = 1 iff that distance exceeds 50.
# "last junction" means the last junction between CODING exons -- exons 1..cds_last_exon, where
# cds_last_exon holds the host's normal stop codon. TOY_PLUS is the gene where that matters: its
# junction at 106 joins two 3'UTR exons and is therefore NOT counted.
# cds_last_exon is the exon HOLDING THE STOP CODON, which is what "last exon" means in the rule.
# TOY_PLUS is the gene where that differs from the last exon of the transcript: its stop codon sits
# in exon 6 while the transcript has 7 exons, because exon 7 is a pure 3'UTR exon behind a 3'UTR
# intron. ACTC (exon 6, still inside the CDS) is therefore "last exon", NOT an internal exon.
